_note: Registry fragment for the two PowerShell sample levers (B-16). NOT loaded by default: it lives with the module, not in levers/registry.d, so the live registry and the demo UI do not list sample levers. Tests load it; to try it, copy it into levers/registry.d/.

levers.name: sampleuser.get
levers.description: Mock read of one user's display name, job title and enabled flag. Sample PowerShell lever.

levers.name: sampleuser.set-title
levers.description: Mock change of one user's job title. Sample PowerShell lever.

title.description: The new job title, letters and basic punctuation only

impact.L1: One person's job title changes in the directory; set the old title back with the same lever.
impact.L2: The client's address book and signatures show the new title; nothing about access or data changes.
impact.L3: A low-risk change the MSP can show an auditor: lead approval, dry-run diff, audit record.
impact.L4: Proves a PowerShell lever can be added with no core change, so many clients get the same tested path.
